candidate_claims.text: Today is October 8, a special day for India.
Friends, As Scindia Ji just mentioned, only yesterday I completed 25 years of serving the nation as the Head of Government.
Friends, This very morning, we received the news that the renowned actor Nana Patekar Ji is no longer among us.
Through his films, he launched powerful attacks on disorder and injustice in society.
In 2022, from this very stage, we launched 5G in the country.
In 2023, I spoke about how India was moving from 5G Roll-out to 5G Reach-out.
Today, we can all see that 5G connectivity has reached every district of the country.
More than 550,000 base stations are now operating across India, providing 5G services.
Mobile internet speeds have increased tenfold compared to 2022.
Friends, At the 2024 edition of India Mobile Congress, we witnessed the presence of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).
The position that India has achieved today in the telecom sector owes much to India Mobile Congress.
Friends, When we talk about telecom, discussions often revolve around networks, spectrum debates, towers, reach, and speed.
During the COVID period, by July 2022, more than 5 billion learning sessions and nearly 600 billion learning minutes had been recorded on this platform.
Our effort now is to connect nearly 250 million students to all our digital and online education platforms.
Through Direct Benefit Transfer, nearly ₹50 lakh crore has reached beneficiaries directly in their bank accounts.
As a result, nearly ₹5 lakh crore has been prevented from falling into the wrong hands.
Nearly ₹5 lakh crore has been saved from misuse.
If the old system had remained in place, around ₹5 lakh crore of government money would have been lost through leakages and would have filled the pockets of such people.
Friends, Under the PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme, we have already deposited more than ₹4 lakh crore directly into the bank accounts of farmers.
It has created new consumers in technology, entertainment, and education, while simultaneously nurturing a new generation of creators.
It is estimated that today more than 500 million people in India are connected to the gaming ecosystem in one way or another.
Youth from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities are also actively participating.
As a result, many language-related barriers and limitations have been removed.
I would also urge GSMA and telecom operators around the world to come together and create a global mechanism that can stop such fraud even before it reaches people.
To achieve this, every necessary incentive is being provided and every necessary reform is being undertaken.
